title: Personnel of Chick Webb's band
summary: Cootie tries to recall the early Chick Webb personnel with Dance.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, let's see, now, in the band there was Trueheart.
Yeah.
Who was the bass player?
I can't remember the bass player. There was a bass player in there. Buford?
I don't know.
I think his name was Buford.
I can check that out with -- and then -- was it Big Greene on trombone?
No.
Who was it, then?
Was it Sandy?
No. Not that early. I don't think so. He did have Big Greene with him, you know. And Johnny wasn't in the band.
No.
Was -- who was the piano player? Not Fulford. That was months later, wasn't it?
No. Who was the piano player there?
A Mexican name?
No. I think Johnny Hodges' brother in law.
Who was his brother in law?
I can't think of his name.

Isn't that funny. I tell you what we'll do. When we take a pause, we'll look it up, to get that personnel. And then we'll put it on tape here, so we've got that. Because that's interesting, that first band you were with with Chick. In fact, I think it's in that article that you and I did. But we'll look it up. We won't bother now. We'll go on from there. I mean, so nobody in the band impressed you that much, but you were kind of thrilled with the band, though, weren't you? With Chick's band then?
Yeah.
Not too, huh?
Yeah.
All you wanted to do was blow.
Yeah. All I wanted to do was blow.
Yeah.
All I wanted to do was blow.
